subject.title: [Bug] QQ Bot: skill_workshop approval "Allow" button always recorded as rejected

question: Should QQ Bot fallback approval buttons ever authorize a C2C sender who is absent from the explicit command or approval allowlists?
rationale: The open PR's unconditional direct-chat exception conflicts with the documented approval policy and a recently published authorization-bypass advisory, but a narrower verified-owner exception could be an intentional product choice.

options.title: Preserve explicit authorization
options.body: Keep the current gate and improve the unauthorized-click response plus setup guidance for `execApprovals.approvers`.

options.title: Allow verified owners only
options.body: Permit implicit C2C approval only when the callback sender matches a separately established owner or pairing identity, with live positive and negative proof.

options.title: Trust every C2C sender
options.body: Accept the proposed direct-chat bypass and explicitly own the resulting expansion of the approval security boundary.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit authorization
recommendation.body: Keep the current gate and improve the unauthorized-click response plus setup guidance for `execApprovals.approvers`.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the current authorization invariant and they are best positioned to confirm whether a narrower exception preserves its security intent.
